blurb: Washington Rock Dance provides dance classes and competitive performance ensembles. They offer pre-professional training tracks including ballet and Youth America Grand Prix training. The studio emphasizes regular attendance, dress code, and provides make-up classes for missed sessions.
extraNote: Tuition is annual divided into 10 equal payments; non-refundable · $25 registration fee per student or $45 per family, non-refundable · $95 costume fee for all dances · No refunds for missed classes; make-ups allowed if scheduled · Inclement weather cancellations announced by email and social media; make-ups allowed; no refunds or credits · Late payment after 15th of month incurs $15 fee and automatic credit card charge
